title: Cartesian stratum restriction with canonical finite constant coefficients
statement:
Let $A$ be a finite commutative ring, $g:Y\to X$ a scheme morphism and $s:S\hookrightarrow X$ an immersion [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-closed-immersion]. Put $S'=S\times_XY$, with projections $s':S'\to Y$ and $g':S'\to S$ [def-pc-fibre-product]. Use the small pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], the constant coefficient rings $A_T$ [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf], and the actual module inverse image $f_A^*M=f^{-1}M\otimes_{f^{-1}A_T}A_{T'}$ with its canonical constant-section coefficient map [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image]. There is a natural isomorphism of $A_{S'}$-module sheaves
$$\theta_M:(s')_A^*g_A^*M\xrightarrow{\sim}(g')_A^*s_A^*M$$
for every $A_X$-module sheaf $M$. On underlying sheaves this is the inverse-image composition comparison associated to $g\circ s'=s\circ g'$. Its coefficient identification agrees along both composition paths with the canonical map for this common composite, sending every constant section $a\in A$ to the same section. It intertwines the $A$-module action maps.

If $s_A^*M$ is locally constant with finite stalks at every geometric point [def-weil-proetale-locally-constant-sheaf, def-weil-proetale-geometric-stalk], then $(s')_A^*g_A^*M$ has these same two properties. This holds for the actual fibre product schemes, with no reduction, Noetherianity or invertibility hypothesis, and includes empty $S'$ and the zero ring.

proof.text: The underlying tensor-unit comparison is invertible by ringUnitComparison in ProEtaleRingSheafChangeAdjunction. Apply it twice to get invertibility of each iterated comparison. These use the specified constant-ring comparison and the normalized module adjunction.

Use the canonical direct-image compositor directComp from ProEtaleModulePullbackComposition and take its adjoint mate moduleComp. Transposing the underlying comparison, naturality of homEquiv, the unit formula for conjugation, and the direct-image section formula prove compComparison_normalization. Cancellation gives its inverse version. The argument is the retained common-universe specialization of the declared module-composition result.

Transport along equality of the two scheme composites. Equality transport is packaged using its proved unique eqToIso value and constant-section compatibility. Compose inverse compositor, equality transport, and compositor. The elementary square_arrows calculation proves the normalization; naturality is naturality of the resulting module natural isomorphism. The packaged sheaf square equals the original explicit composite by proEtaleCartesianStratumSheafComparison_eq.

Apply the coefficient composition equation on snd,g and fst,s. Cancel the first sheaf compositor against its inverse in the square, use the uniquely specified equality transport on constant-section coefficient maps, and obtain the second coefficient equation.

Apply proEtale_finiteLocalConstancy_pullback along fst to the restriction along s. Insert or remove the True predicate to identify the two local-constancy presentations. Compose local trivializations with overFunctor.mapIso theta. Apply each geometric module stalk functor to theta and transfer finiteness through the resulting bijection. The construction is categorical, hence also covers empty schemes and the zero ring.

It has no new nodes and no fixes. The delivery adds a five-step proof and leaves the statement, stmt_deps and blueprint unchanged; it is one commit with the report. The statement is true for any morphism s; the immersion hypothesis is unused. I tested it on empty S', s=id, A=0 and A=F_4. Source: Stacks 093R (sites-modules.tex l.8435) states the pullback of a locally constant module sheaf over a fixed ring is locally constant, with the proof omitted, so proof_origin agent is correct. Step 1: prop-weil-pbc-proetale-constant-ring-map says c_u is invertible; contracting the tensor pullback m⊗a↦c^{-1}(a)m with inverse m↦m⊗1 is elementary. Step 2: lem-pur-proetale-constant-ring-composition, applied to (s',g) and (g',s) with t=gs'=sg', gives c_t=c_{s'}(s')^{-1}(c_g)α_1=c_{g'}(g')^{-1}(c_s)α_2; this uses only its statement. Step 3: θ=α_2α_1^{-1} is A_{S'}-linear by naturality of α_i on the action map, with finite products preserved by lem-weil-pbc-left-exact-site-inverse-image-tensor and the step-2 equation; this is elementary. Step 4: lem-pur-proetale-finite-local-constancy-pullback with b=g', F=s_A^*M has exactly the item's hypotheses. Composing trivializations with θ restricted to U_j, and taking stalks of θ, carries both properties over. Step 5: the degenerate cases follow from the empty-source clause. This matches what step 2 of the parent lem-sf-finite-immersion-constructibility-interval needs on each stratum S_ν×_X Y. Duplicate search over all nodes for locally constant together with fibre products: lem-exc-proetale-pullback-locally-constant, lem-fd-constructible-tensor-refinement-witness and lem-sfb-adic-finite-stratification-pullback are related but none states the item. There is no cycle. Tool uses: I accept the three off-unit generic tools (constant-ring-map, constant-ring-composition, left-exact inverse image). lem-pur-proetale-finite-local-constancy-pullback is in sk-def-sf-operations, which the unit cites, so its tool_uses entry is unnecessary but harmless. No SGA is cited.
